source: 707 Compulsion
target: 707 Compulsio

source: In the dark, silent tunnel, Franca advanced slowly, holding the Primordial Demoness figurine made of bone.
target: In obscuro et silente cuniculo, Franca lente procedebat, tenens effigiem Demonissae Primordialis ex os factam.

source: Her footsteps were so soft they were nearly inaudible.
target: Vestigia eius tam levia erant ut fere inaudibilia essent.

source: Lumian, clutching his carbide lamp, and Jenna trailed silently behind her.
target: Lumian, lampadem carbidae tenens, et Jenna silentio eam sequerentur.

source: With a Hunter’s keen understanding of the terrain and memories, the three had finished exploring the area where they had obtained the classic silver mirror.
target: Cum venatoris acuta intellegentia de regione et memoriis, tres finiverant explorare locum in quo speculum argenteum classicum adepti erant.

source: They had even expanded their search to include the nearby underground tunnels and connected quarry caves.
target: Etiam indagationem suam dilataverunt ut includerent cuniculos subterraneos proximos et speluncas fodinarum conexas.

source: However, the Primordial Demoness figurine showed no abnormal reactions, and neither Franca nor Jenna sensed anything out of the ordinary.
target: Tamen, effigies Demonissae Primordialis nullas reactiones anormales ostendit, neque Franca neque Jenna aliquid insolitum sensit.

source: Franca sighed.
target: Franca suspiravit.

source: “Well, this is disappointing.”
target: “Heu, hoc vere deludens est.”

source: “Bold assumptions leading to a shameful failure!”
target: “Audaces coniecturae ad ignobilem cladem ducunt!”

source: She had no intention of giving up, but wanted to return to the surface first and contact 007.
target: Non habebat propositum cedere, sed primum ad superficiem redire voluit et 007 contingere.

source: She hoped to use the authorities’ detailed records of underground abnormalities to search for any areas where a high-level Demoness’s power might be seeping out.
target: Sperabat uti accuratis tabulis ab auctoritatibus de anomaliis subterraneis ad quaerendas regiones, in quibus potentia Demonissae altissimae exfluere posset.

source: Having experienced numerous mystical incidents, Lumian surveyed the area, pondering for a few seconds.
target: Multa mystica experientia habens, Lumian regionem perspexit et paulisper meditatus est.

source: “Let’s investigate again.”
target: “Iterum investigemus.”

source: “This time, I’ll extinguish the carbide lamp.”
target: “Hoc tempore, lampadem carbidem exstinguam.”

source: “In mysticism, Demonesses and the mirror world are always associated with darkness, evil, and quiet depth.”
target: “In mystica, Demonissae et mundus specularis semper cum tenebris, malitia, et quieta profunditate coniunguntur.”

source: “Perhaps subtle reactions can occur in the absence of light.”
target: “Forsitan reactiones subtiles in absentia lucis fieri possint.”

source: “Subtle reactions… What is this, a chemistry experiment?”
target: “Reactiones subtiles… Quid hoc est, experimentum chemicum?”

source: Franca scoffed, but chose to comply.
target: Franca irridens dixit, sed obtemperare statuit.

source: She turned to Jenna.
target: Ad Jennam se vertit.

source: “Hold your Mirror World Fragment in your hand.”
target: “Tene fragmentum Mundi Specularis in manu tua.”

source: “If we’re giving this a shot, we should try everything.”
target: “Si hoc experiemur, omnia conari debemus.”

source: Jenna took out the Mirror World Fragment she had obtained from the Tamara family tomb, and Lumian turned the switch to extinguish the carbide lamp.
target: Jenna extraxit fragmentum Mundi Specularis, quod ex sepulcro familiae Tamara adeptus erat, et Lumian rotam vertit ad lampadem carbidem exstinguendam.

source: The silent tunnel plunged into absolute darkness.
target: Cuniculus silentiosus in tenebras absolutas cecidit.

source: As a Hunter, Lumian couldn’t see a thing.
target: Ut venator, Lumian nihil videre poterat.

source: “You can hold onto my sleeve,” Jenna suggested calmly.
target: «Manicam meam tene,» Jenna tranquille proposuit.

source: “Or activate your Spirit Vision and follow our spiritual light.”
target: «Aut spiritum visionem tuam activa et lucem nostram spiritualem sequere.»

source: Lumian replied with a smile, “That would make me look weak. I suspect you’re deliberately showing off. Have you forgotten? I can gain night vision by changing my life form.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit, "Id me debilem apparere faceret. Suspicio te deliberanter ostentare. Oblitus es? Mutando formam meae vitae, nocturnam visionem adipisci possum."

source: Jenna was silent for a moment before retorting,
target: Jenna paulisper silentium tenuit antequam replicavit,

source: “Dammit! Would it kill you to be a bit nicer about it?”
target: “Heu! Num te occidat, si paulo amabilius ageres?”

source: “She’s right,” Franca agreed.
target: «Illa recte dicit,» Franca assentivit.

source: “Jenna was just trying to help.”
target: «Jenna solum auxilium ferre conabatur.»

source: “It’s fine if you don’t want her assistance, but there’s no need to mock her.”
target: «Licet auxilium eius non desideres, sed non necesse est eam deridere.»

source: “That’s a Hunter for you.” Lumian chuckled as he activated the black mark on his body, transforming into a shadow creature.
target: «Ita sunt venatores.» Lumian subridens activavit notam nigram in corpore suo, transformatus in creaturam umbratam.

source: He blended into the shadows and followed Franca and Jenna as they explored the area for the second time.
target: Se in umbras misit et Francam atque Jennam secutus est dum locum secundum iterum explorabant.

source: As Franca passed a corner of a quarry cave, she suddenly felt the bone figurine in her hand tremble slightly.
target: Dum Franca angulum speluncae fodinarum transibat, subito sensit effigiam ossis in manu eius paulum trepidare.

source: “There’s a reaction! There’s a reaction!” she exclaimed joyfully.
target: «Est reactio! Est reactio!» exclamavit laete.

source: Lumian immediately left the shadows, transforming back into human form, his blue eyes tinged with silver-black.
target: Lumian statim umbras reliquit, iterum in formam humanam transformatus, oculis caeruleis argento-nigros tinctis.

source: In the absolute darkness, he saw the mercury rivers of fate belonging to Franca and Jenna.
target: In tenebris absolutis vidit flumina mercurii fati, quae Francae et Jennae erant.

source: As his spirituality rapidly depleted from the brief observation, Lumian found a possibility among the tributaries symbolizing Franca’s future fate.
target: Dum spiritualitas eius ex brevi observatione celeriter exhauebatur, Lumian inter affluentes, qui futurum fati Francae symbolizabant, opportunitatem invenit.

source: This was something that might happen in ten seconds or more.
target: Hoc erat aliquid quod in decem secundis aut ultra fieri posset.

source: Furthermore, the probability of it occurring was extremely low—something Curse, or rather, Magnify, couldn’t influence.
target: Praeterea, probabilitas evenendi eius valde exigua erat—aliquid quod Curse, aut potius Magnify, non poterat influere.

source: Without hesitation, Lumian extended his right palm toward Franca.
target: Sine mora, Lumian dextram manum in Francam protulit.

source: Franca, with her night vision, witnessed his actions and noticed his silver-black eyes.
target: Franca, cum nocturna visione, eius acta conspexit et oculos eius argento-nigros animadvertit.

source: She jumped in fright.
target: Ex metu exsiluit.

source: “W-what are you doing?”
target: «Quid facis?»

source: She didn’t dodge, fully trusting Lumian.
target: Non evasit, pleno fidens in Lumiano.

source: Lumian roused his spirituality, transforming it into a violent illusory river that surged out of his palm.
target: Lumian spiritualitatem excitavit, eam in flumen violentum et fallacem transformans, quod ex palma eius profluebat.

source: Franca’s fate was instantly thrust into a future by the mighty torrent.
target: Fatum Francae statim in futurum per imponentem torrentem immissum est.

source: Compelling Fate!
target: Fatum Impellens!

source: Franca suddenly had an idea.
target: Franca repente ideam cepit.

source: “Are you influencing my future, allowing me to successfully utilize the corrupted fate fragments here to make it a reality?”
target: “An fatum meum influas, et me sinas fragmenta fati corrupta hic efficaciter uti ad eam re veram efficiendam?”

source: “Dammit, I really do have an idea. Maybe I should give it a try!”
target: “Heu, vere ideam habeo. Forsitan conari debeam!”

source: Lumian, his spirituality greatly depleted, chuckled. “Life is short, why not give it a try?”
target: Lumian, spiritualitate multum exhausa, subridens respondit, "Vita brevis est; cur id non conemur?"

source: ƈοm
target: ƈοm

source: “…” Franca could clearly detect the mockery in his tone.
She gritted her teeth.
target: Dentes contraxit.

source: “I’ll deal with you later!”
target: “Te postea curabo!”

source: As she spoke, Franca placed the Primordial Demoness’s bone figurine on a protruding rock in a corner of the mine.
target: Dum loquebatur, Franca effigiam ossis Demonissae Primordialis in saxo protuso in angulo fodinae posuit.

source: Then she took out a mirror and placed it in front of the figurine.
target: Deinde speculum extraxit et ante effigiam collocavit.

source: Lumian conjured a blazing white fireball and observed as Franca retrieved essential oils, extracts, perfume, and herbal powder from her Traveler’s Bag, preparing for the ritual.
target: Lumian globum ignis albi fulgentis evocavit et observavit Francam, quae ex sacculo viatoris olea essentialia, extracta, unguentum, et pulverem herbarum extraxit ad ritum praeparandum.

source: Uh… Lumian turned to Jenna, who happened to look back at him.
target: Eh... Lumian ad Jennam se convertit, quae ad eum respiciebat.

source: Franca simultaneously turned to face them.
target: Franca simul ad eos se vertit.

source: The three were taken aback for a moment before bursting into laughter.
target: Tres paulisper obstupefacti sunt, deinde risu erumpere coeperunt.

source: “You two thought of it too?” Franca said happily.
target: «Et vos duo id cogitastis?» Franca laete dixit.

source: “Jenna shouldn’t stay here. The Primordial Demoness might cast Her gaze here later.”
target: «Jenna hic non manere debet. Demonissa Primordialis fortasse hunc locum postea intuetur.»

source: As a pure female Demoness, it would definitely not bode well for Jenna to be noticed by the Primordial Demoness. It could even mean death.
target: Ut pura Demonissa feminina, certe non deceret Jennam ab Demonissa Primordiali notari; etiam mortem significare posset.

source: Lumian replied with a smile, “I’ll send Jenna back first and come back after the ritual.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit: "Primum Jennam remittam et post ritum revertar."

source: With that, he reached out and grabbed Jenna’s shoulder.
target: Hoc facto, extendit manum et umerum Jennae arripuit.

source: Jenna said to Franca, “Be careful.”
target: Jenna Francae dixit: "Cave."

source: “Don’t worry, I’m a skilled worker,” Franca replied, waving her hand cheerfully.
target: «Noli timere, artifex peritus sum,» Franca respondit, manum laete movens.

source: As a member of the Demoness Sect, she regularly prayed to the Primordial Demoness through the bone figurine, following the Demoness of Black’s instructions.
target: Ut membrum Sectae Demonissae, regulariter orabat ad Demonissam Primordialis per effigiam ossis, praecepta Demonissae Nigrae sequens.

source: Occasionally, she even held a solo Mass.
target: Interdum etiam solam Missam celebrabat.

source: Of course, this was the first time she would be praying to the Primordial Demoness through a ritual.
target: Certe, hoc primum tempus erat quo per ritum ad Demonissam Primordialis oraretur.

source: After Lumian teleported away with Jenna, the quarry cave returned to darkness.
target: Postquam Lumian cum Jennā evanuit, spelunca fodinarum in tenebras rediit.

source: With the bone figurine, Franca decided to use a dualistic ritual.
target: Effigiam ossis habens, Franca decrevit rituum dualisticum uti.

source: After lighting the candle representing herself, she drew her needs on a faux goatskin with the corresponding symbols and patterns, drawing upon her extensive mysticism knowledge.
target: Postquam candelam sibi repraesentantem accendit, in pelle caprina ficta requisita sua cum symbolis et figuris congruentibus depinxit, ex vasta scientia mystica confisi.

source: Following that, she sanctified the ritual silver dagger and created a wall of spirituality.
target: Deinde, cultrum argenteum rituale sanctificavit et murum spiritualitatis creavit.

source: She dripped rose essential oil, musk, and perfume into the candle flame.
target: Oleum essentiale rosarum, muscus, et unguentum in flammam candelae stillavit.

source: Franca’s heart skipped a beat as the alluring, complex scent quickly entered her nostrils.
target: Cor Francae paulisper titubavit, cum venustus et multiplex odor celeriter in naribus eius intravit.

source: She couldn’t help but inhale deeply.
target: Non potuit quin alte inspiraret.

source: After completing all the preparations, Franca took two steps back and recited the Primordial Demoness’s honorific name in Hermes.
target: Postquam omnia praeparationes confecta sunt, Franca duos gradus retro se recepit et nomen honorificum Demonissae Primordialis in Hermes recitavit.

source: “The source of all catastrophes, the symbol of destruction and the apocalypse, the Demoness who controls Chaos.”
target: «Fons omnium catastropharum, symbolum destructionis et apocalypsis, Demonissa quae Chaos regit.»

source: In the altar, a small amount of moss suddenly grew, entangling into vines that rose high, as if staring at Franca.
target: In altare, parva quantitas muschi subito crevit, implicata in vitis quae alte surrexerunt, quasi Francam intuentes.

source: The ground softened, and a frigid wind blew, causing Franca to tremble.
target: Solum mollivit, et ventus frigidus flat, faciens Francam trepidare.

source: Simultaneously, Franca sensed the fragrance in the area grow sweeter, carrying a warm charm that made her blush.
target: Simul, Franca sensit odorem in regione dulciorem fieri, ferentem calidam venustatem quae eam rubescere faciebat.

source: This invigorated her specific desires, and charming scenes surfaced in her mind.
target: Hoc excitavit specifica desideria eius, et in mente eius scaenae amoenae apparuerunt.

source: Suppressing the heat in her body and shaking off her discomfort, Franca briefly recounted how Moran Avigny was a Mirror Person and how she wanted to capture him.
target: Calorem in corpore suo reprimens atque molestias abigendam, Franca breviter recitavit quomodo Moran Avigny Persona Specularis esset et quomodo eum capere vellet.

source: Then, following the ritual’s standard procedure, she said,
target: Deinde, rituum consuetudinem sequens, dixit:

source: “I pray for the power of the mirror."
target: "Precō potentiam speculi."

source: “I pray for the power of chaos."
target: "Precō potentiam caosi."

source: “I pray for God’s protection."
target: "Precō pro tutela Dei."

source: “I pray for a fixed entrance to the mirror world to appear here."
target: "Precō ut hic introitus fixus ad mundum specularis appareat."

source: “Roses, a herb that belongs to the Demoness, please pass your power to my incantation."
target: "Rosae, herba quae Demonissae competit, quaeso, potentiam vestram incantationi meae tradite."

source: “Musk, a herb that belongs to the Demoness, please pass your power to my incantation…”
target: "Muscus, herba quae Demonissae competit, quaeso, potentiam vestram incantationi meae tradite…"

source: After reciting the incantation, Franca ignited the faux goatskin and placed it on the mirror in front of the bone figurine.
target: Incantationem recitata, Franca pellem caprinam fictam accendit et in speculo ante effigiam ossis posuit.

source: As the faux goatskin burned away, Franca felt the candle flame dim, as if a layer of translucent mullioned glass had materialized around it.
target: Dum pella caprina ficta ardebat, Franca sensit flammam candelae attenuari, quasi stratum vitreae translucidae circa eam apparuerit.

source: A strange power was activated, gathering in the mirror.
target: Vis insolita activata est, in speculo congregata.

source: The human-head-sized mirror suddenly darkened, turning shadowy and illusory.
target: Speculum, quod mensura capitis humani erat, subito obscuratum est, umbratile et fallace illusum.

source: It melded with the protruding rock where the figurine was placed and vanished.
target: Illud cum saxo protuso in quo effigies posita erat, confluit et evanuit.

source: In the next moment, the candle flame returned to normal, and the fragrance lingering in the air still unsettled Franca.
target: In proximo momento, flamma candelae ad statum normalem rediit, et odor in aere residens adhuc Francam perturbavit.

source: Her thoughts raced, requiring immense strength to control herself.
target: Cogitationes eius celeriter errabant, requirentes ingentem vim ad se coercendum.

source: After tidying up the bone figurine and other items, Franca took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
target: Postquam effigiam ossis et alias res ordinavit, Franca alium spiritum profundum traxit et lente exhalavit.

source: Dammit, just the charm and pleasure emanating from the ritual nearly made me lose myself.
target: Heu, sola venustas et voluptas ex ritu effluentes paene me perdere fecerunt.

source: All I wanted was to approach the source of the charm and enjoy the pleasures bestowed by Her.
target: Omne quod volui fuit accedere ad fontem venustatis et frui voluptatibus ab Ea donatis.

source: As expected of the Primordial Demoness who controls pleasure and feminine charm…
target: Ut exspectabatur a Demonissa Primordialis quae voluptatem et venustatem feminam regit…

source: Dammit! I’m an idiot.
target: Heu! Idiota sum.

source: Why did I take a deep breath?
target: Cur spiritum profundum sustuli?

source: The smell here hasn’t dissipated!
target: Odor hic nondum evanuit!

source: I need to quickly confirm if there’s an entrance to the mirror world before heading back to Jenna…
target: Celeriter comprobare debeo an introitus ad mundum specularis adsit, antequam ad Jennam redeam.

source: As these thoughts raced through Franca’s mind, she saw Lumian’s figure swiftly materialize at the edge of the quarry cave.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem Francae transibant, vidit figuram Lumiani celeriter in margine speluncae fodinarum apparere.

source: Franca jumped in fright.
target: Franca ex metu exsiluit.

source: “Why are you back already?”
target: «Cur iam rediisti?»

source: Lumian chuckled. “You’re in pretty good shape. Didn’t I say I’d return after your ritual…?”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: "Recte valeas; nonne dixi me post ritum tuum redire?"

source: As he spoke, Lumian noticed Franca’s lake-blue eyes rippling under the dim candlelight, as if they could captivate one’s soul.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian animadvertit oculos Francae, caeruleos ut lacus, sub tenui lumine candelae undulantes, quasi animam alicui capere possent.

source: Lumian’s words faltered.
target: Verba Lumiani vacillaverunt.

source: After a brief pause, he added, “Besides, Jenna was worried about you and asked me to come check on you.”
target: Post brevem pausam, addidit: "Praeterea, Jenna de te sollicitabat et me rogavit ut te inspicerem."

source: I believe the Primordial Demoness can understand that a Demoness of Pleasure has a friend who cares about her.
target: Credo Demonissam Primordialis intellegere posse quod Demonissa Voluptatis amicum habeat qui de ea curare possit.

source: “Yeah.” Franca nodded gently, bit her lip, and pointed at the protruding rock.
target: «Ita.» Franca leniter annuit, labrum contraxit, et ad saxim protusum indicavit.

source: “That spot seems to have become a fixed entrance to the mirror world. Let’s see if we can enter.”
target: «Illud loco videtur introitus fixus ad mundum specularis factus esse. Videamus num intrare possimus.»

source: Lumian didn’t inquire further.
target: Lumian non amplius quaesivit.

source: He approached the protruding rock and, together with Franca, extended his right palm, pressing it against the cold stone.
target: Accedens ad saxim protusum, et una cum Franca, dextram manum protulit atque eam in lapidem frigidum prementem.

source: A faint light flickered, and the two vanished on the spot.
target: Lumen tenuis micans apparuit, et duo in loco evanuerunt.

source: After a brief moment of vertigo, a dark, illusory path appeared before Lumian and Franca’s eyes.
target: Post brevem momentum vertiginis, via obscura et illusoria ante oculos Lumiani et Francae apparuit.

source: Surrounding them were numerous similar “tunnels,” intertwining to form a complicated and mysterious colossal spiderweb.
target: Circum eos erant multa similia cunicula, quae inter se implicabantur, formantes reticulum araneum ingens, multiplex et arcana.
